jobs.title: Content Production Intern
jobs.description:
The Content Production Intern will provide hands-on operational support to the Photo Studio & content team, contributing to the daily organization and execution of e-commerce, lookbook and campaign shootings. The role will support the team throughout the production workflow, from shooting planning and sample preparation to freelance coordination, administrative follow-up and final asset delivery, ensuring that activities are accurately organized and completed according to seasonal priorities and deadlines.

CORE JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Photo Studio Planning & Shooting Operations

Sample Management & Production Tracking

Freelance & Administrative Coordination

Post-production & Asset Delivery

Advertising Campaign & Location Shooting Support

## Requirements
- Degree or ongoing studies in Marketing, Communication, Fashion, Business or a related field.
- Previous experience in fashion, e-commerce, photography or production will be considered a plus.
- Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
- Excellent organizational and multitasking skills with strong attention to detail.
- Hands-on attitude and willingness to work on highly operational activities.
- Ability to manage multiple tasks, changing priorities and tight deadlines.
- Proactive, reliable and solution-oriented approach.
- Strong interpersonal skills and ability to interact with different internal departments, freelancers and external partners.
- Good communication skills and fluency in English.
- Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

## Benefits
- An International, fresh and dynamic working environment
- Physical & Mental Health programs, sustainable projects and workshop promoted by Guess Cares
- Arts, sports and social events outside the office, thanks to our Guess Fun activities!
- Training & Development platform and paths
- Discount on our products both online and in stores

jobs.title: Designer Outlet
jobs.description:
The Designer will be responsible for researching and interpreting emerging fashion and consumer trends, translating them into commercial products that reflect the Factory Outlet brand identity and meet customer expectations. By identifying new product opportunities and developing commercially relevant collections, the designer will play a key role in driving the evolution of the assortment while collaborating closely with Merchandising and Buying, and Product Development teams. According to their level of expertise, the designer will independently manage advanced design activities and contribute to strategic product decisions.

CORE JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

## Requirements
- Bachelor Degree or Diploma in Fashion and/or Design Arts.
- At least 3-4 years of experience in the same role and field.
- Strong knowledge of fashion and emerging trends.
- Strong attitude and understanding of fashion product, style, and graphic trends.
- Creative, with a clear understanding of the brand DNA, and a very pragmatical approach.
- Fashion eye with commercial awareness.
- Ability to handle multiple tasks/projects with adherence to deadlines and design calendar.
- Dynamic personality, fast thinker, positive attitude.
- Availability for traveling if needed.
- Sense of urgency and flexibility
- Fluent English.
- Good knowledge of computer skills: Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
- Extensive experience with Adobe CS software, including Illustrator and Photoshop
- 3D design skills preferred (Clo 3D).

## Benefits
- An International, fresh and dynamic working environment
- Physical & Mental Health programs, sustainable projects and workshop promoted by Guess Community
- Arts, sports and social events outside the office, thanks to our Guess Fun activities!
- Training & Development platform and paths
- Discount on our products both online and in stores

Attraverso l'individuazione di nuove opportunità di prodotto e lo sviluppo di collezioni commercialmente rilevanti, il designer svolgerà un ruolo chiave nella guida dell'evoluzione dell'assortimento collaborando a stretto contatto con i team di Merchandising and Buy e Product Development. jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for a self-driven and experienced professional with a strong understanding of social media, fashion and culture, and a refined eye for content. You will help shape how GUESS connects with audiences through digital storytelling, campaigns and cultural moments.

This is a role with a high level of ownership, combining strategic thinking with hands-on execution, cross-functional collaboration and the ability to drive projects forward from concept to delivery.

Your mission is to ensure GUESS digital content and channels reflect the brand’s vision and DNA through a social-first approach. You will translate campaign ideas into platform-native storytelling, bringing together cultural relevance, creative excellence and measurable impact. Most importantly, you will help shift GUESS from social supporting campaigns to social actively shaping them.

CORE JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

## Requirements
- 7/8 years of experience in social media, digital marketing and/or communications within fashion, lifestyle, retail or another culturally relevant consumer brand
- Proven experience developing and implementing global or multi-market social media strategies
- Deep understanding of Instagram, TikTok and other relevant social platforms, including formats, communities, publishing workflows, paid amplification and performance drivers
- Demonstrated experience managing social media calendars, campaigns and multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced, international environment
- Strong fashion, design and cultural awareness, with a refined visual sensibility and excellent taste. Able to translate trends and contemporary aesthetics into authentic, visually compelling brand content, particularly for platforms such as Instagram
- Strategic yet hands-on, able to translate big-picture thinking into actionable plans and drive effective execution from concept to delivery
- Strong understanding of organic and paid social media, and how they work together to support broader business and brand objectives
- Experience managing or mentoring team members, with strong leadership, communication and collaboration skills
- Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to present strategies, performance insights and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders
- Strategic and analytical mindset, combining an understanding of creative storytelling and brand building with the ability to interpret social media performance and translate data into actionable recommendations.
- Experience using social media analytics, reporting and publishing tools, such as Sprout Social, with familiarity with content creation tools such as Canva
- Experience with AI tools and emerging technologies relevant to social media is a plus
- Fluent English and Italian; additional languages are a plus

## Benefits
- An International, fresh and dynamic working environment
- Physical & Mental Health programs, sustainable projects and workshop promoted by Guess Cares
- Arts, sports and social events outside the office, thanks to our Guess Fun activities!
- Training & Development platform and paths
- Discount on our products both online and in stores

descriptionByLocale.it:
Siamo alla ricerca di un professionista self-driven ed esperto con una forte comprensione dei social media, della moda e della cultura, e un occhio raffinato per i contenuti. Aiuterai a modellare come GUESS si connette con il pubblico attraverso la narrazione digitale, campagne e momenti culturali.

Questo è un ruolo con un alto livello di proprietà, combinando il pensiero strategico con l'esecuzione pratica, la collaborazione interfunzionale e la capacità di guidare i progetti avanti dal concetto alla consegna.

La vostra missione è quella di garantire contenuti digitali e canali GUESS riflettono la visione e il DNA del marchio attraverso un approccio social-first. Tradurrete idee di campagna in narrazione basata sulla piattaforma, mettendo insieme rilevanza culturale, eccellenza creativa e impatto misurabile. Il più importante, aiuterà a spostare GUESS dalle campagne di sostegno sociale a social attivamente modellarli.

RISPOSTE DI GIOCO

## Requisiti
- 7/8 anni di esperienza nei social media, digital marketing e/o comunicazioni all'interno della moda, dello stile di vita, del retail o di un altro marchio di consumo culturalmente rilevante
- Esperienza comprovata nello sviluppo e nell'attuazione di strategie di social media globali o multi-mercato
- Profonda comprensione di Instagram, TikTok e altre piattaforme sociali rilevanti, tra cui formati, comunità, flussi di lavoro di pubblicazione, amplificazione a pagamento e driver di performance
- Esperienza dimostrata che gestisce i calendari dei social media, le campagne e i progetti multipli simultaneamente in un ambiente internazionale veloce
- Forte moda, design e consapevolezza culturale, con una raffinata sensibilità visiva e un gusto eccellente. In grado di tradurre tendenze ed estetica contemporanea in contenuti di marca autentici e visivi, in particolare per piattaforme come Instagram
- Strategico ma hands-on, in grado di tradurre il pensiero di grande immagine in piani attuabili e guidare l'esecuzione efficace dal concetto alla consegna
- Forte comprensione dei social media organici e retribuiti, e come lavorano insieme per sostenere obiettivi di business e brand più ampi
- Esperienza di gestione o mentoring membri del team, con forti capacità di leadership, comunicazione e collaborazione
- Ottima capacità di comunicazione e presentazione, con la capacità di presentare strategie, intuizioni sulle prestazioni e raccomandazioni chiaramente agli stakeholder senior
- Mindset strategico e analitico, combinando una comprensione di storytelling creativo e brand building con la capacità di interpretare le prestazioni dei social media e tradurre i dati in raccomandazioni attuabili.
- Esperienza utilizzando strumenti di analisi, reporting e pubblicazione dei social media, come Sprout Social, con familiarità con strumenti di creazione di contenuti come Canva
- L'esperienza con gli strumenti AI e le tecnologie emergenti rilevanti per i social media è un plus
- Inglese fluente e italiano; lingue aggiuntive sono un plus

## Vantaggi
- Un ambiente di lavoro internazionale, fresco e dinamico
- Programmi di salute fisica e mentale, progetti sostenibili e workshop promossi da Guess Cares
- Arte, sport e eventi sociali fuori dall'ufficio, grazie alle nostre attività Guess Fun!
- Piattaforma e percorsi di formazione e sviluppo
- Sconto sui nostri prodotti sia online che nei negozi

- Strategische und analytische Denkweise, die ein Verständnis von kreativem Storytelling und Markenaufbau mit der Fähigkeit verbindet, die Leistung von Social Media zu interpretieren und Daten in umsetzbare Empfehlungen zu übersetzen.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un professionnel autonome et expérimenté avec une forte compréhension des médias sociaux, de la mode et de la culture, et un œil raffiné pour le contenu. Vous aiderez à façonner la façon dont GUESS se connecte avec le public à travers la narration numérique, des campagnes et des moments culturels.

Il s'agit d'un rôle avec un haut niveau d'appropriation, combinant la pensée stratégique avec l'exécution pratique, la collaboration interfonctionnelle et la capacité de faire avancer les projets d'un concept à l'autre.

Votre mission est de s'assurer que le contenu et les canaux numériques GUESS reflètent la vision et l'ADN de la marque par une approche sociale. Vous allez traduire les idées de campagne en narration plate-forme-native, rassemblant la pertinence culturelle, l'excellence créative et l'impact mesurable. Plus important encore, vous aiderez GUESS à passer des campagnes de soutien social à les façonner activement.

RESPONSABILITÉS D'EMPLOI DE BASE

## Exigences
- 7/8 ans d'expérience dans les médias sociaux, le marketing numérique et/ou les communications dans la mode, le style de vie, le commerce de détail ou une autre marque de consommation culturellement pertinente
- Expérience éprouvée en matière d ' élaboration et de mise en œuvre de stratégies mondiales ou multimarchés de médias sociaux
- Compréhension approfondie d'Instagram, de TikTok et d'autres plateformes sociales pertinentes, y compris les formats, les communautés, la publication de flux de travail, l'amplification payante et les moteurs de performance
- Expérience démontrée dans la gestion simultanée de calendriers, de campagnes et de projets de médias sociaux dans un environnement international rapide
- Mode forte, design et conscience culturelle, avec une sensibilité visuelle raffinée et un excellent goût. Capable de traduire les tendances et l'esthétique contemporaine en un contenu de marque authentique et visuellement convaincant, en particulier pour les plateformes comme Instagram
- Stratégique mais pratique, capable de traduire la pensée grand-image en plans concrets et de conduire une exécution efficace du concept à la livraison
- Une bonne compréhension des médias sociaux bio et payants et de la façon dont ils travaillent ensemble pour soutenir les objectifs plus larges des entreprises et des marques
- Expérience de la gestion ou du mentorat des membres de l'équipe, avec de solides compétences en leadership, en communication et en collaboration
- Excellente capacité de communication et de présentation, avec la capacité de présenter clairement des stratégies, des points de vue sur le rendement et des recommandations aux intervenants supérieurs
- Un état d'esprit stratégique et analytique, combinant une compréhension de la narration créative et la création d'une marque avec la capacité d'interpréter la performance des médias sociaux et de traduire les données en recommandations concrètes.
- Expérience de l'utilisation d'outils d'analyse, de reportage et de publication de médias sociaux, comme Sprout Social, avec une connaissance des outils de création de contenu comme Canva
- L'expérience avec les outils d'IA et les technologies émergentes pertinentes pour les médias sociaux est un plus
- Anglais et italien; langues supplémentaires sont un plus

- Un environnement de travail international, frais et dynamique

- Remise sur nos produits en ligne et en magasin
